marketing.metaTitle: Pickld: eight moments, one real day
marketing.metaDescription: Pickld is a photo diary for the day you actually had. Fill a jar with eight moments, decorate them with stickers and let your friends read along. Coming soon to iPhone.

hero.body: Pickld is a photo diary for the day you actually had. Fill a jar with eight photos, from where you are to how your evening went, then let your friends read it.
hero.jarAlt: Mika’s Friday on Pickld: a jar of photos, each labelled with its moment, like #whereami and #ootd

form.label: Email address
form.note: We’ll only email you about Pickld’s launch.

moments.title: One jar a day. Eight moments to fill.
moments.body: Every moment has its own slot, so your jar tells the whole day, not just the highlight. A new jar starts at midnight.
moments.label: The eight moments

how.title: Snap. Decorate. Share.
how.snapBody: Take the photo and it drops into the right slot. No signal? It’s saved on your phone and uploads later.
how.snapAlt: Thursday’s jar on Pickld with eight moments, each with the time it was taken
how.decorateBody: Color filters, stickers, speech bubbles and text. No beauty filters or face retouching, ever.
how.decorateAlt: Pickld’s photo editor with a row of color filters under the photo
how.shareBody: Publish your jar for the people who read you, or turn a moment or the whole jar into a card for your Stories, with your pickld.me link on it.
how.shareAlt: A Pickld jar card for Stories: three photos, the caption “lunch crew” and Dale’s Thursday, 3 of 8

stickers.title: Meet Olivia
stickers.body: Olivia is a real cat: white, fluffy and not impressed. She has her own sticker pack, next to free packs for every moment and packs made for very Pinoy days.
stickers.shopAlt: The Stickers screen on Pickld with the Christmas pack and packs like Pinoy Life and Barkada

privacy.title: Yours, on your terms
privacy.body: Every jar picks its own audience when you publish it.
privacy.readersBody: The people you let read you. This is the default.
privacy.everyoneBody: Anyone with the link, and your page at pickld.me.
privacy.onlyMeBody: Keep this jar just for you.
privacy.private: A single moment can be private too. Private moments stay with you: never in feeds, shares or notifications.

memories.title: Look back without scrolling
memories.body: On this day brings back your jar from a year ago, monthly recaps add up your moments, and a home screen widget keeps today’s jar one tap away.
memories.memoriesAlt: Memories on Pickld: a jar from one year ago and an October recap
memories.widgetAlt: The Pickld widget on an iPhone home screen: 4 of 8 moments today, next up #whoamiwith

faq.title: Questions
faq.freeA: Yes. Jars, readers and the free sticker packs cost nothing. Some extra sticker packs will cost a little, and what you buy is yours to keep.
faq.androidA: Pickld starts on iPhone. Android comes later; join the waitlist and we’ll tell you when it’s ready.
faq.whoA: Your readers, unless you choose otherwise. Make a jar Everyone to share it with a link, or Only me to keep it to yourself. You can block anyone.
faq.fullQ: Do I have to fill all eight?
faq.fullA: No. A jar holds up to eight moments, and messy, half-full days count too.
faq.missedQ: What if I miss a moment?
faq.missedA: Fill it in later. Any past day can be filled, and those moments get a small “Added later” badge so your readers know.
faq.ageQ: How old do I need to be?
faq.label: Frequently asked questions
